description: Central Province Provincial Councils - Appointed Mr. G. K. G. T. D. Gedarakumbura and 17 others to the Central Province
categorisation: This gazette contains only government personnel changes (appointments and assignments to overlook positions) with named individuals and their basic titles/ranks (e.g., S.L.A.S. III, S.L.A.S. I). While it mentions departments and ministries, it does not include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas for these individuals. The content focuses solely on who is being appointed to which positions without elaborating on what those positions specifically entail in terms of policy areas or functional responsibilities.
